converted: "A-Reverb": Reverb (as Fruity Reeverb 2) → mixer insert 17, with their settings.
"B-Delay": Delay (as Fruity Delay 3) → mixer insert 18, with their settings.
Mixer: 2 groups and 2 returns routed as in Live.
"KICK (MIDI)": 13 extra plugin outputs → the mixer inserts of the tracks that took them in Live.
